title: How to bypass 2GB file size limit?

posts.author: SkyBlue_the_Alicorn
posts.body:
So I've tried to do some research for this topic but I haven't found anywhere reliable or that wasn't from ten years ago, so I want to ask real quick.
Does anyone know of a way I can compress my game so that I can bypass the file size limit on RPG Maker VX Ace? The game I'm making isn't massive per se but i think with the movies and graphics it'll likely surpass 2GB. I want to avoid lowering the quality of the movies or graphics especially. I would prefer avoiding installing any outside software to do it but if it's proven to work and is safe than I wouldn't mind knowing about it!
Thank you!

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
I do believe any limits on VX Ace is with the data size are with all the graphics.
I do not know if movies are included. Audio is not.
My project compressed it 2.4gb but I have about 2.2GB of audio.
Compressing the game and extracting works fine.
I have not had enough graphics to test the game.rgss3a file.
Make a quick test. Put a large movie in the movies folder and compress the game. See if it extracts properly and plays.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
As said above, audio is not compressed again (those files are already compressed by the audio codec, making a second try to compress them a bad idea).
If I remember correctly some people removed the audio folder from the game and re-added it after compression and installing the game to get the encryption on the files, then use a different and more modern archive or setup creator.
